title: Research: PR2809 ScratchPool lease-end annotations and CALL empty-pool cut (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independent audit of Jose Manuel / jmbarrancoml’s PR2809 ScratchPool lease-end annotations and the leading `pool.empty()` cut on `Machine.call`, as named in `docs/research/selected-bit-physical-contract-map.md` open question 2 (lease-end / CALL invariants remaining after opcode/source and residual/CALL packages).

At the pinned PR2809 bytes: a stale clear preserves a later borrower of the same physical role; `Machine.call` begins with `pool.empty()`, so a live lease cannot cross the recursive cut on the successful path; three semantic omission mutants show the active guard, live-map release, and call-site empty check are load-bearing. Sources are pin-authenticated; the algebra is independent of importing the live ScratchPool class.

This discharges only the named lease-end / CALL-empty slice. It does not complete universal refinement review, interrupt/abort recovery, residual/CALL packet composition, or H2 pricing. Selected decimal unchanged.

**No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/selected-bit-lease-end-call/`
- Tip: `e4fa89214086fb096c4276bbea891a1e6fae6c7b`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **refined** — lease-end annotations + CALL empty-pool cut only

Closest priors: PR2809 `selected-bit-physical-caller` (implements the annotations); Nick Petalas `physical-compiler-correspondence` (opcode/source; leaves scratch/CALL unproved); Nick Petalas `residual-call-refinement` (residual/CALL packets). Soft overlap ≈0.25–0.40 vs those leave-alone audits (different obligation); not a ~0.9 retarget.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/selected-bit-lease-end-call/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/selected-bit-lease-end-call/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/selected-bit-lease-end-call/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/selected-bit-lease-end-call/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-bit-lease-end-call
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_SELECTED_BIT_LEASE_END_CALL stale_clear_preserves_borrower call_requires_empty_pool three_mutants no_new_kappa
PASS_SELECTED_BIT_LEASE_END_CALL_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/selected-bit-lease-end-call outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Credit

Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Compose this lease-end cut with residual/CALL refinement and whole-word NODE/MERGE ownership.
2. Bind fixed scratch-role initialization and marker provisioning to a complete machine-step invoice.
3. Independently audit interrupted-macro recovery (successful-path only here).
